subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank no.3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **listens**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is in context to the fact that the author will see that the school council **pays attention** to them.
 
• **Listens:** to take notice of or believe what somebody says; pay attention.
 
• The rest of the options are contextually incorrect.

Therefore, the correct answer is: I will make sure that the school council ***listens*** to us.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The meanings of the rest of the options are given below in the table:

 
 

 **Word**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 **Accepts**
 

 to agree to take something that somebody offers you
 
 

 **Hears**
 

 to receive sounds with your ears
 
 

 **Believes**
 to feel sure that something is true or that somebody is telling the truth
